visualCharacteristics: Centred call-to-action band with no panel background: heading, a paragraph with authored line breaks (hidden on small screens) and a big button.
contentPattern: One cell: heading, one or more paragraphs, and a bold-italic link rendered as the big button.
usage: Closing call to action near the bottom of the homepage and listing pages.
reuseGuidance: Use for a short centred prompt with a heading, a sentence or two and one button.
